opportunities.title: YouTube Post-Production Editor & Motion Graphics Specialist
opportunities.location: Remote (Indeed India listing; eligibility from UAE not stated)
opportunities.summary: Edit long- and short-form YouTube videos, create After Effects motion graphics and thumbnails, and use AI-assisted production tools. Indeed lists this as remote; confirm UAE eligibility with the employer.

opportunities.title: AI Animation Video Creator/Editor for Weekly Children's YouTube Series
opportunities.summary: Build a weekly children's animated series with consistent characters and backgrounds, AI animation tools, and polished episode edits. Worldwide listing; ongoing work with potential contract-to-hire.

opportunities.title: Short-form video editor (reels)
opportunities.pay: Your rate · agreed before work starts
opportunities.summary: Edit 20–60 second vertical reels from supplied footage, puppet scenes and voice-over; add captions, sound and simple motion for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts. Apply with a reel portfolio and rate.

opportunities.title: Freelance Video Editor / Motion Designer / 3D Animator
opportunities.location: Remote · UAE and other countries accepted
opportunities.summary: Join Quantumstrat's remote freelance roster for short-form social, YouTube, brand films, explainers and product animation. The listing accepts applicants in the UAE; portfolio and 3+ years' experience requested.

opportunities.title: AI Video Artist
opportunities.summary: Create AI-generated visuals for cinematic ad films and branded content. Eleventh Door describes itself as remote-first and invites portfolio submissions for its listed AI Video Artist opening.

opportunities.title: Vibe Marketer
opportunities.summary: Produce short-form AI-assisted marketing videos, ads, social clips and product content, owning campaigns end to end. Babou says it hires globally and accepts full-time or near full-time availability.

opportunities.title: 2D Animator
opportunities.summary: Create character and effects animation for StarWorks original animated work. The listing asks for a reel, strong draftsmanship and timing, and production-pipeline experience.
